parallelism.reason: Limits context duplication and subscription usage while preserving useful concurrency.

routing_rules.when: deterministic command can do the work
bounded implementation, stable contract, local judgment
ambiguous architecture, shared contract, integration, high-risk repair

followup_fast_lane.purpose: Cheap, dependable execution of non-blocking cleanups captured as complete task packets during review/integration. Quality is guaranteed by deterministic gates and fail-closed qualification, not model horsepower.
qualify: complete pre-built task packet exists in state/followups.json
deterministic verifier fully covers the change
no shared contract, protected path, dependency, CI, auth, or schema change
followup_fast_lane.disqualified_action: eject to the full verified-diamond workflow

reviewer.policy: skip when deterministic gates fully cover the change; otherwise diff-only scoped review

batching.verification: affected-scope checks per item; full configured gates once per batch
batching.drain_hint: prefer draining immediately after the main run while context caches are warm

followup_fast_lane.deterministic_first: if a formatter, lint --fix, codemod, or generator covers the item, the packet procedure is that command plus verification; route to mechanical
followup_fast_lane.telemetry_calibration: record lane/worker_class/model/effort/retries/escalated/outcome per item; if more than 10% of the trailing 20 fast-lane items escalate, raise the default fast-lane builder effort to medium and investigate

privacy.logs: metadata only; redact command arguments and output by default
